_doc: BRAIN HUNTER s14. In-document anchors for MFKCTU+CambriaMath in arXiv:1601.00991. The font subset stripped every Unicode channel (/Differences carries raw GIDs, post=3.0, cmap is a synthetic PUA identity), so no font-level recovery is possible. These anchors are recovered from the PAPER'S OWN prose, which names each symbol immediately before showing it -- e.g. 'the annualized Sharpe ratio <g1845>'. Each is evidence, not assumption, and each carries the sentence it came from.

anchors.evidence: same sentence; the index pair i>j
the ubiquitous alpha-index subscript on S/T/C/R
second subscript of the correlation matrix

derived_blocks.note: italic Latin uppercase; five mutually consistent anchors (C,N,R,S,T)
italic Latin lowercase, contiguous with the uppercase block (1827+26); anchors i,j

not_recoverable.greek: Italic Greek is NOT block-recoverable: rho=g2006 implies base 1990, sigma=g2026 implies base 2008. Cambria Math interleaves variant forms (epsilon/theta/phi/pi/rho/sigma), so Greek must be anchored per symbol. Named as a residual, not silently guessed.
